'''''Dawn of Light''''' was a sculpture made by the famous [[Artist/Legends|artist]] from [[Aurea]], [[Kasa Xanter]]. The [[Thief/Legends|thief]] [[Bryn Shale]] claimed she would steal it during its exposition at the [[Vorheim Gallery]].
